title: Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.01892v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal agents commonly generate free-form reasoning before each action. For small models, limited model capacity can result in lengthy reasoning that provides little useful guidance for action generation while incurring substantial inference cost. To address this challenge, we introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as selection instead of open-ended generation. SSR represents recurring high-level reasoning as pre-specified, reusable natural-language candidates. At each turn, the model selects from these reasoning candidates based on their likelihoods given the current context, without requiring an auxiliary task head. Using pre-specified reasoning traces enables parallel scoring, where teacher-forced prefilling computes token likelihoods concurrently within and across candidates using a shared context KV cache. translated_title: 基于选择的结构化推理：迈向高效的多模态搜索智能体
translated_abstract: 多模态智能体通常在每次执行动作前生成自由形式的推理。对于小模型而言，有限的模型容量会导致冗长的推理，这不仅对动作生成几乎提供不了有用的指导，还会带来巨大的推理开销。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了基于选择的结构化推理框架（Selection-based Structured Reasoning，SSR），该框架将推理重新表述为选择，而非开放式生成。SSR将反复出现的高层推理表示为预先指定的、可复用的自然语言候选。在每一轮中，模型基于当前上下文下的似然从这些推理候选中进行选择，无需任何辅助任务头。使用预先指定的推理轨迹使得并行评分成为可能，即通过教师强制预填充（teacher-forced prefilling）并借助共享的上下文KV缓存，在候选内部和候选之间并发计算token似然。我们在七个多模态搜索基准上使用2B和……的模型对SSR进行了评估。
tldr: 提出基于选择的结构化推理框架SSR，将开放式推理生成转化为从预定义推理候选中的似然选择，并借助共享上下文KV缓存实现并行评分，从而大幅提升小模型多模态搜索智能体的推理效率。
en_tdlr: We propose Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), which replaces open-ended reasoning with likelihood-based selection from pre-specified reasoning candidates and enables parallel scoring via a shared context KV cache, substantially improving the inference efficiency of small multimodal search agents.
